text:
I had a consultation with a doctor who was quite condescending. He sat there asking patients with kidney disease what they shouldn't eat. The patient replied, "Drink water" (he had recently had pulmonary edema and was mistaken). The doctor pressed the patient further until he himself said they shouldn't eat salt or fermented fish sauce. It seemed all "Isaan people" (Northeast Thailand) were the same; they all eat fermented fish sauce.

However, the doctor's medical advice was okay afterwards. Personally, I wouldn't bring anyone here again unless absolutely necessary. Different circumstances apply; if you don't mind the doctor's way of speaking, you can come.
